evidence_policy.privacy_rationale: Private logistics are withheld for safety, not secrecy: exposing them creates avoidable risk of theft, scams, impersonation, harassment, or physical/logistics targeting.

amazon_wishlist.evidence_rule: Purchased items should appear as purchased on the wishlist; safe follow-up evidence can be added after receipt.

hardware_or_store_credit.evidence_rule: Log item or amount, intended use, status, and safe evidence such as redacted receipt or component/build photo.
